Summary of websites posted in the 'general' channel:

1. www.informations.com — Reports on the latest job report, noting a mix of relief and concern as unemployment edged down to 7.2%.

2. www.restaurant-zurich.com — Zurich Restaurant is a cozy, alpine-inspired eatery in the heart of the city, known for authentic Swiss cuisine. The menu features traditional dishes like cheese fondue, rösti, and chocolate fondue. Warm wooden interiors with Swiss memorabilia create a rustic atmosphere, and guests enjoy panoramic city views through large windows. Friendly staff in traditional Swiss attire complete the experience.

Hi Dora! I just visited your personal website (www.dora-website.com). It's a nice, clean start, and it's great that you've included your contact email so people can reach you. One suggestion: you could add a bit more about yourself — like your interests, background, or a short bio — to make the site feel more personal and engaging. Also, consider adding a few visual elements or a portfolio section to showcase your work. Keep it up!

Hi Eve! I just checked out your blog (www.eve-blog.com). It's lovely that you share your passion for hiking — that's a wonderful hobby to write about! To make your blog even more engaging, you could add posts about your favorite trails, photos from your hikes, tips for beginners, or stories from your adventures. A bit more content and some visuals would really bring it to life. Happy hiking!
